portfolio.title: Personal Web Portfolio
portfolio.description: Personal website developed to show my professional profile as a developer and music creator, combining modern design and real content.
portfolio.description_extended: This project is much more than a cover letter; it is an interactive platform designed to merge my identity as a developer and music producer.
portfolio.philosophy_desc: "Technology and art are not separate disciplines, but layers of the same experience. This project was conceived as a space where every technical decision —from the architecture to the animations— has a clear purpose: to improve the way the user perceives and consumes the content. The main focus was not complexity, but clarity, performance and consistency. Each component is reusable, each animation is subtle and each external integration is thought to provide real value, not just visual impact."

silent_decay.title: SILENT DECAY
silent_decay.subtitle: Psychological Horror Game
silent_decay.description: Psychological horror video game developed from scratch under the XEVORA label. Currently in advanced development stage.
silent_decay.about_desc: Silent Decay is a first-person psychological horror experience where survival depends on understanding what hunts you and deciphering the rules that govern this hostile environment.
silent_decay.menu_audio_desc: Experience the visual and sound design of the game's main menu. Turn on the audio to listen to the atmospheric soundtrack designed to immerse the player in the psychological horror experience.
silent_decay.progress_subtitle: Advanced stage of production, refining core features

hospital.desc: An abandoned and claustrophobic clinical environment. Narrow corridors where visibility is minimal and every sound is magnified.

industrial.desc: Massive warehouses and heavy machinery areas. Open but dark industrial spaces, with dynamic mechanical and environmental hazards.

tunnels.desc: Underground network of wet and flooded tunnels. Acoustics are your greatest enemy, and the water hides threats lurking beneath the surface.

silent_decay.core_design_desc: "Every creature has a rule. Learn it. Survive it."

bookhead.name: Bookhead
bookhead.desc: A methodical hunter equipped with conical raycasting vision. Reacts to movement noise and silently inspects the player's last known positions.

rastrero.name: El Rastrero
rastrero.desc: A twilight stalker that leaves a dynamic trail of fluids in its path. Aggressive in the dark, but retreats to the shadows when illuminated directly by the flashlight.

phenomen.name: Phenomen
phenomen.desc: A psychotropic entity that distorts sanity and the environment. Triggers visual hallucinations and procedural environmental events that progressively degrade the player's mind.

replica.name: La Réplica
replica.desc: An entity of progressive metamorphosis (inert mannequin to biomechanical monster). Stalks and strategically relocates on the map only when the player breaks visual contact.

ai.title: AI & Enemy Systems
ai.desc: AI based on FSM (Finite State Machines), advanced NavMesh navigation, dynamic FOV calculation with raycasting, and unique behaviors for each creature.

world.title: World Generation
world.desc: Modular and procedural generation of levels, spatial connectivity validation algorithms, and dynamic environmental events.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.desc: Sanity mechanics, stealth, noise detection, physical environment interactions, and complex integrated puzzles.

ui.title: UI & Tools
ui.desc: Dynamic data-driven interfaces, configurable menu systems, and internal testing tools to optimize iteration.

silent_decay.about_p1: Silent Decay has been conceived from its foundation as a development environment to test and implement scalable architectures in Unity 6 and C#. It is not just a horror game, but a laboratory for interactive systems development.
silent_decay.about_p2: The project focuses on solving gameplay challenges, code stability in complex procedural systems, dynamic interface modularity, and agent optimization with artificial intelligence.
silent_decay.gallery_desc: Real screenshots of the Unity inspector, AI design, environments, and gameplay.
silent_decay.cta_title: Do you want to know more about the game's architecture?
silent_decay.cta_desc: I am open to discussing technical decisions, code modularity, and collaborations in Game Dev.
